{{Top|leg}}
A '''Sontaran song ball''' was made from [[Titanium/Legends|titanium]] alloy from the [[Sontara system/Legends|Sontara system]]. It was composed of a sphere within another sphere. When the ball was moved, it produced a sonorous note similar to a [[Flute/Legends|flute]].<ref name="CN3">''[[Coruscant Nights III: Patterns of Force]]''</ref>
